description: This file contains unit tests for the AppState's remote gateway configuration logic, verifying token handling and state preservation across mode and transport changes.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test functions for validating remote configuration behaviors.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that a remote gateway config sets the token value correctly by trimming whitespace.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Verifies that the token is cleared when an empty or whitespace-only string is provided.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that the object token is preserved across mode and transport transitions when unchanged.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that a secret reference token is replaced by plaintext when the user provides a new token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Confirms that the secret object token is only cleared after user explicitly clears or modifies the token.
